body.statement: For every \(C\in\mathbb R^{n\times N}\), \(C\in\mathcal D_G\) if and only if there exists a matrix \(Q=I_N-B\) with exact support \(G\), with \(Q\) and every \(Q_{V\setminus S,V\setminus S}\) invertible, such that \(C=(Q^{-1})_{X,:}\). The backward direction must construct linearly independent representatives from the punctured affine fibers, complete them with the observed columns, and recover every edge coefficient without taking a generic or closure limit.
body.justification: This is the structural-completion theorem that turns exact support and all cancellation strata into finite rank and matching data.
body.gap: Dai et al. use generic matroid and closure arguments for a zero-allowed observational class; this claim is an exact all-parameter realization theorem for punctured affine fibers and intervention minors.
body.consumer: Every later containment and enumeration result needs a graph-only certificate that a candidate observed mixing matrix comes from an admissible feedback mechanism.
